description: The Sovereign Academy is a parent education and product organization focused on personal sovereignty: the knowledge and practical ability to make important decisions with more understanding, more control, and less dependence. Its current work includes financial education (Financially Sovereign Academy) and Bitcoin education (Bitcoin Sovereign Academy).
